opening.argument: The video directs viewers to deploy a supplied smart contract, set up MetaMask, and send 0.2 BNB to it for stated swap fees. It then presents the procedure as producing a 2.51 BNB gain for the transaction sender, while the narration describes approximately 2.57 BNB in profits from the script. The claims extend beyond a single example: viewers are told that a 5,000 BNB flash loan is “almost guaranteed to work every time,” and that larger flash loans offer better chances of profitable execution. Although the material is labeled educational and warns of possible losses, those qualifications do not change the profit-oriented solicitation, specific favorable returns, or instructions to transfer funds and execute the contract.
